programme.title: Ip Man (2025)
programme.desc: Behind every great martial artist lies a teacher. Ip Man, starring Donnie Yen, is the award-winning film adaptation about the life story of Ip Man, grandmaster of Wing Chun and mentor to legendary kung fu superstar Bruce Lee. Set in Fo Shan, China during the Sino-Japanese War, Ip Man vividly brings to life the brutality of the infamous Japanese occupation, where once proud men are forced to fight to the death for a precious bag of rice. Defined by courage and humility, Ip Man, whose fighting skills are revered all over China, rises to the fore front. Upon refusing to teach his martial arts to the invading Japanese soldiers, he is forced to fight for the honor of his country in a series of battles that will culminate in a kill-or-be-killed showdown with Japan’s greatest fighter.

programme.title: Ip Man 2: Legend of the Grandmaster (2024)
programme.desc: International superstar Donnie Yen reprises his iconic role as the real-life kung fu grandmaster Ip Man, widely created as the man who brought Wing Chun kung fu to the world with the help of his star pupil- Bruce Lee. Master Ip, a new arrival in British-occupied Hong Kong, wants to open a martial arts academy to teach his unique Wing Chun style. A corrupt cabal of martial arts masters, led by Master Hung (Sammo Hung) refuses to allow him to teach in peace until he proves himself in a series of fights against the local master, which Ip does, in style. But even after earning the respect of the local masters, Ip’s troubles are far from over. Hong Kong under British rule is a new world of corruption and conflict between the Chinese locals and the British expats that run the city. When a Western-style boxer named “Twister” (Darren Shahlavi) comes to town to entertain the Brits, he insults Chinese martial arts in a horrifically violent way, and Ip is forced by honor to enter a brutal “King of the Ring” boxing match against Twister- and it’s East versus West in an amazing, knock-down drag-out fight to the finish.

But crossing the U.S. without a penny to his name proves difficult. Lyon then takes up the sport of bare-knuckle fighting, earning him the money to reach his destination and support his loved ones -- but with the Foreign Legion hot on his trail, will he ever find peace?

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: Italy is one of the very few nations in the world that regularly gets three major extreme natural phenomena – volcanos, flooding, and avalanches. Eastern flanks of the volcano to slip by up to two metres, and many houses on the flanks of the volcano experienced structural damage. The eruption also completely destroyed the Rifugio Sapienza, on the southern flank of the volcano. The Rifugio was the site of a cable car station which had previously been destroyed in the 1983 eruption; both have now been rebuilt. The most recent eruption was in November 2006.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.sub-title: Angry Planet | By Camel to Timbuktu
programme.desc: It is time for “Angry Planet” to do a serious desert episode. What better place to do it than this fabled city in the middle of the mighty Sahara Desert.This almost mythical place really does exist. And it really is still possible to travel there by camel caravan, riding the infamous “Ships of the Desert”. Extreme heat, dehydration, possible sand storms, frigid night temperatures and desert predators are our potential companions for the trip.

programme.title: Angry Planet

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: No-one creates eco-disasters on quite the scale of the former Soviet Union. In Uzbekistan, the Aral Sea, once one of the largest freshwater lakes in the world, has seen its waters diverted, so that it has shrunk to 1/6 its previous size. In Crimea, a mountain has been carved into a james bondian submarine base. In northern Ukraine, the Chernobyl nuclear site has been reduced to a radioactive wasteland.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: George returns to the “Fin Del Mundo” at the southern tip of Argentina, this time to sail on a Russian icebreaker to Antarctica. After braving the stormy Drake passage, he explores volcanic Deception Island, camps out in the Antarctic snow, and paddles a kayak through icebergs calved off the melting glaciers.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: Filming the volcanoes, mudpools and geysers in the geothermic wonderland of New Zealand’s north island, we learn that a new island is being created by an undersea volcano 1000 miles north in Tonga. Determined to be among the first to see this “newest land on earth”, we head for the remote island by plane and boat, after various nautical mishaps, George ends up, bedraggled and clad in nothing but underwear and a lifejacket, honored to be one of the very first to explore this brand new island.

programme.title: Angry Planet

He travels on mountain bike, steam train and Cessna to experience the huge fires and meet the northern fire crews battling the blazes.

programme.title: Angry Planet

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: Mount Washington, New Hampshire has the dubious title of being home to the world’s worst weather. The highest wind ever recorded on the planet – 231 miles per hour – was recorded at its mountaintop observatory. To prepare for a mid-winter assault on the summit, Angry Planet host George Kourounis becomes a “human popsicle”, encased in ice in at the National Resarch Council’s high speed wind tunnel. Then he and his sidekick Mark Robinson climb to the top of the mountain in mid-January and brave their way into a summit blizzard.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: Dominica, the most volcanic and mountainous island in the Caribbean, is home to the Boiling Lake, a large waterfall-fed lake of furiously boiling water. Adventurer George Kourounis becomes the first person ever to traverse across the lake on a rope, risking his life to take water samples and shoot video from a place no human has ever been. He then dives to the ocean floor off the coast of the island to explore vents where the superheated water bubbles into the ocean.

programme.title: Angry Planet

programme.title: THE WAWIES (2025)
programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

2018 es un thriller de supervivencia en malayalam basado en las devastadoras inundaciones de Kerala de 2018. programme.title: Go Astro Boy Go!
programme.desc: Mientras el Dr. Blunt realiza un experimento de telepatía con una chinchilla, que deja su mente temporalmente atrapada en el cuerpo del animal, el Equipo Astro investiga los misterios del teatro "embrujado". Suzu sube al escenario y canta. ¡Ay! Astro y Astro-Kitty piensan que su voz chillona debería ser suficiente para espantar a cualquier fantasma, pero los ruidos inquietantes continúan hasta que el Equipo Astro descubre al enamorado Derek, un ave lira capaz de reproducir cualquier sonido humano, los cuales incorpora en una canción con la esperanza de atraer a una pareja. Él y Suzu cantan a dúo y casi "echan abajo el teatro" cuando sus voces funden el cableado defectuoso de los micrófonos y provocan un incendio. El Equipo Astro apaga el fuego y salva el teatro y, para sorpresa de todos, la canción de Derek le consigue una pareja.

programme.title: Hecho en Chinatown (2024)

programme.title: La Lucha de un Guerrero (2025)

Está a punto de completar su misión cuando recibe un disparo y vuelve a la vida solo para darse cuenta de que ha perdido la memoria. Mientras tanto, Kavya Sharma se ocupa de él mientras otros funcionarios de la agencia gubernamental de élite, Murthy y Jai Rathod, están ocupados pensando cómo hacer que Om regrese a la misión. Pero no es tan sencillo como parece desde fuera. Mientras salva a su nación, Om tiene mucho más por descubrir: por ejemplo, encontrar a su padre Dev Rathod y demostrar que no era un traidor.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Every season, just like clockwork, mission-driven longboards gobble their way across the plains of South Dakota, the cornfields of Iowa, the timbered ridges of Michigan and the cattle ground of Kansas looking for their soulmates in one of the most celebrated hunting seasons in America…the wild turkey breeding season. Join Team Winchester as they stalk, call, flank and roost boss gobblers into range from coast to coast.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew heads to Colorado to field test Winchester’s new Supreme Long Range ammunition—engineered for hunters who demand precision at extended distances. Featuring the BC Max bullet, built with a high ballistic coefficient, heat-resistant tip, and match-grade components, this round is designed for flatter trajectories, reduced wind drift, and devastating terminal performance. - After confirming zero and studying real-world drop and wind deflection at the range, the team heads into Colorado’s rugged backcountry in pursuit of mule deer and elk. With fresh snow, steep canyons, and long shooting lanes, the terrain offers the perfect proving ground to see how the new bullet performs under pressure. - From close-range opportunities to challenging cross-canyon shots, this hunt puts the technology—and the hunters—to the test in one of the West’s toughest landscapes.

programme.title: Behind The Draw

programme.title: HuntStand Presents
programme.desc: The West Texas desert has a way of pulling you in. In Desert Ghost, Will Cooper heads west to Marathon, Texas, with longtime friend and mentor Cody Roberts to hunt aoudad in one of the most remote landscapes in the state. Rooted in family legacy, this film explores Cody’s deep ties to the desert, the story behind Desert Ghost Distillery, and the mystique of a western oasis near Big Bend National Park. More than a hunt, Desert Ghost dives into the role of aoudad management and its importance to desert bighorn sheep conservation efforts led by Texas Parks and Wildlife and the Wild Sheep Foundation. Sometimes, to protect what belongs here — you have to chase the ghosts. You really do have to be tough, determined, or one lucky bastard to make it out in West Texas.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Gregorio es atracado en Bogotá sin recibir ayuda. Séptimo Día realiza un experimento social con actores para observar reacciones ante robos. Las respuestas varían entre ayuda y miedo. El sociólogo Carlos Charry analiza la falta de empatía y solidaridad. Las autoridades insisten en que deben ser ellas quienes actúen, no los ciudadanos.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: En un país donde las motos son el corazón del transporte rural, tragedias silenciosas desgarran familias enteras. Cifras alarmantes reflejan la necesidad urgente de conciencia y firmeza en normas de tránsito.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Dos niños mueren luego de ser sedados para procedimientos dentales y las familias exigen respuestas.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.sub-title: La niña de los sueños rotos
programme.desc: En 2012, en La Virginia, Risaralda, Angie Xiomara, una niña de 9 años, desapareció mientras estaba al cuidado de su tío, Víctor Alfonso Cardona. Días después, su cuerpo fue hallado en un cañaduzal. Testigos y evidencias llevaron a la captura de Cardona, quien confesó el crimen. Fue condenado a 50 años de prisión por homicidio agravado y acceso carnal violento contra su sobrina.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Valentina Mugno, de 14 años, fue hallada asesinada en su casa en Valledupar en 2011, tras quedar sola una noche. La investigación inicial involucró falsamente a un amigo y a su hermana antes de identificar a Víctor Alfonso Márquez como sospechoso. Una segunda víctima que logró sobrevivir un ataque similar fue clave para el caso. Casi seis años después, Márquez fue condenado a 44 años de prisión.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En 2009, Ángela María Mejía confesó matar a su esposo Edilson Guzmán. Sus amigos Pedro y Yolanda la encubrieron, pero Yolanda luego descubrió que Pedro era amante de Ángela y la delató. Ángela fue capturada por homicidio y otros delitos.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En Cajamarca, Tolima, el líder ambientalista César García fue asesinado frente a su familia tras oponerse a la minera AngloGold Ashanti. Aunque se sospechó de un vínculo con la empresa, las autoridades lo descartaron. Una carta de suicidio reveló que el verdadero autor fue Álvaro Meléndez, vecino con quien García tuvo un litigio de tierras. Meléndez permanece detenido esperando juicio.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En 2013, Andrés Felipe Fierro, joven ingeniero ambiental, fue asesinado en 'Charco Azul', Florencia, Caquetá. La investigación reveló que Rocío Quintero, su amante, y Jarol Villegas, esposo de ella, estuvieron involucrados en el crimen. Un testigo clave confirmó las sospechas. Jarol confesó ser el autor intelectual y fue condenado a 32 años de prisión. Rocío permanece prófuga, rehaciendo su vida en Argentina.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En 2016, en la Sierra Nevada de Santa Marta, dos hermanos desaparecieron cerca de la vereda Nuevo Mundo. Tras sospechar inicialmente de la madre, la investigación reveló que David Barbosa Arrieta, empleado de confianza del padre, había abusado y asesinado a los menores. Las pruebas recopiladas confirmaron su culpabilidad, y Barbosa fue condenado a 60 años de prisión.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En 2016, en Socorro, Santander, Yesenia Bernal fue asesinada para robarle a su bebé recién nacido. Su amiga Edilsa María Díaz, tras perder su propio embarazo y temiendo perder a su pareja, fingió estar embarazada y planeó el crimen junto a Juan Carlos Vega para apropiarse de la niña. Ambos fueron capturados y condenados: Edilsa a 35 años y Juan Carlos a una pena similar.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Michelle está demandando a Michael y Nuri por negligencia y pérdida comercial después de que su spa de alta gama se dañó cuando los lechones de Michael y Nuri fueron liberados y se volvieron locos en su negocio.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Wilbur y su esposa, Lucia, están demandando a la hermana de Wilbur, Jennifer, por $200,000 después de que su hijo quedó fuera del testamento de su abuela.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Jennifer Lozada, de 46 años, demanda a su esposo y a su amante por enajenación de afecto.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Los Wilson demandan a Sean Moore, patrocinador de Ballpark Bandits, por 10.000 dólares. Su hijo fue despedido a mitad de temporada, Sean culpa al comportamiento errático de Kevin y a Laurie por fomentar la negatividad e intimidar a los padres.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Alexa está demandando a su novio de un año y medio por cancelar abruptamente el viaje de su vida porque necesitaba traer a su hijo de 7 años.

programme.title: Los Informantes
programme.desc: Adriana y Laura, mujeres que eligieron la maternidad subrogada en Colombia, enfrentan críticas y regulaciones. Hilda Niño, exfiscal, vive bajo custodia tras denunciar corrupción. Duván, bailarín caleño, supera adversidades y triunfa en el arte.

programme.title: Rabbit Trap (2025)
programme.desc: A musician couple captures a sound not meant for human ears. Soon, a stranger knocks on their door and their reality begins to blur.

programme.title: The Wave (English dub) (2016)
programme.desc: The very day he’s about to drive his family to a new life in the city, geologist Kristian Elkjord senses something wrong with the mountain that overlooks his scenic town.

programme.title: Mayday (2021)
programme.desc: Ana joins an army of girls engaged in a never-ending war. Ana trains as a sharpshooter and discovers newfound freedom and courage. Though she finds strength, she comes to realize that she’s not the killer they want her to be.

programme.title: Marrowbone (2018)
programme.desc: Four young siblings vow to stay together when their mother dies. But when a ghostly presence torments them and a lawyer threatens their pact, the four must stand together or be torn apart forever.

programme.title: Nature Calls (2012)
programme.desc: Determined to honor his father's scouting legacy an Assistant Scoutmaster convinces a group of kids to secretly ditch a slumber party in favor of a weekend scout trip.

programme.title: Results (2015)
programme.desc: Recently divorced, newly rich, and utterly miserable, Danny [Kevin Corrigan] would seem to be the perfect test subject for a definitive look at the relationship between money and happiness.

programme.title: Honeymoon (2015)
programme.desc: A newlywed couple's idyllic country-lake honeymoon descends into chaos.

programme.title: Little Joe (2020)
programme.desc: Alice (Emily Beecham) has engineered a special flower that makes its owner happy. Against company policy, Alice takes one home to her son. As their plant grows, so does Alice's suspicion that her new creation may not be as harmless as they thought.

programme.title: Zero Days (2016)
programme.desc: The Stuxnet virus cyber-attack launched by the U.S. and Israel unleashed malware with unforeseen consequences. Delve deep into the burgeoning world of digital warfare in this documentary thriller.

programme.title: White Bird In A Blizzard (2015)
programme.desc: Kat Connors' (Shailene Woodley) glamorous but strange mother Eve vanishes. Kat is excited by her new freedom but disturbing facts surface and the mystery begins to haunt her.

programme.title: In the Fade (English dub) (2018)
programme.desc: Golden Globe® Winner for best foreign language film. Katja’s family is killed in a terrorist attack and her life falls apart. The killers are set free and Katja can do nothing else but seek justice.

programme.title: Shadow Dancer (2013)
programme.desc: When a young mother and true believer from a violent IRA family is captured by British spies, she is forced to betray everything she believes in for the sake of her son in this taut, high-stakes thriller.

programme.title: Rage at Dawn (1955)
programme.desc: A special agent (Randolph Scott) poses as a train robber to infiltrate Frank Reno's (Forrest Tucker) outlaw gang.

programme.title: Raiders of Old California (1957)
programme.desc: After the war with Mexico, cavalry officers try to steal land from Mexican peasants to establish their own empire.

programme.title: The Fighting Redhead (1949)
programme.desc: Red Ryder helps his old friend Dan O'Connor in his fight against Faro Savage and his gang of rustlers.

programme.title: Rawhide Rangers (1941)

programme.title: Robin Hood of the Pecos (1941)
programme.desc: A night rider (George "Gabby" Hayes) and his singing partner (Roy Rogers) send Texas carpetbaggers packing.

programme.title: New Mexico (1951)
programme.desc: After the Civil War, cavalryman Capt. Hunt tries to strike peace with Acoma, a Native American chief. However, Judge Wilcox and others provoke Acoma, arresting him and shooting his men, prompting revenge from the chief.

programme.title: Song of Arizona (1946)
programme.desc: A youth from Gabby Whittaker's (George "Gabby" Hayes) Half-a-Chance Ranch for boys from troubled homes becomes a pawn in the fight between his late father's gang and Roy Rogers.

programme.title: Hands Across the Border (1943)
programme.desc: A singing cowboy (Roy Rogers) helps a slain rancher's daughter (Ruth Terry) breed horses for the Army.

programme.title: Public Cowboy, No. 1 (1937)

programme.desc: A barmaid, a Bostonian and an Indian (Rita Gam) flirt with an artist (Scott Brady) in 18th-century upstate New York.

programme.desc: A Denver widow (Conchata Ferrell) with a daughter becomes a Scottish rancher's (Rip Torn) housekeeper in 1910 Wyoming.

programme.title: The Star Packer (1934)

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Fred & Carrie convince the Mayor to launch a campaign to ban the Olympics from Portland. Guest stars Greg Louganis, Kyle MacLachlan, Johnny Marr.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Portland's hottest brunch spot welcomes all the residents of Portlandia... but there's a wait. Guest stars Tim Robbins Kyle MacLachlan, Steve Jones.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: It's wintertime in Portlandia. Peter and Nance struggle to keep off winter weight by cutting pasta from their diets. Candace's son (Bobby Moynihan) visits Women and Women First bookstore for the holidays.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: In this Season 3 premiere, Spyke & Iris join forces with a gang of former MTV stars to take back MTV from the Tweens. A group of frustrated college grads stage a protest on the dance floor. Sandra has a crush on a man in her meditation class.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: The Mayor sends Fred and Carrie on a door-to-door mission to Seattle to recruit new citizens for Portland. A pedicab driver hustles for clients. Peter and Nance prepare for the opening of their Bed and Breakfast with a visit to The Doily Shoppe.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Nina goes to great lengths to throw an extravagant 32nd birthday party for herself. The daylong event is set to include activities ranging from horseback rides to sunrise yoga that will last well into the night.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Concerned parents Brendan and Michelle start a band that makes kids music. The Portland Nerd Council issues a Public Service Announcement. Malcolm & Kris have an uncomfortable lunch at a vegan restaurant. The Feminist Bookstore hosts a comedy night.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Following an environmental scandal, The Mayor steps down from office and moves off the grid. A dolphin discovers that plastic bags have been banned in Portland. Musicians compete in a Battle of the Gentle Bands.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: A temp worker hopes to turn her gig as Interim Mayor of Portland into a full-time job with Fred and Carrie's help. A wedding is interrupted. Local baristas draft a coffee shop manifesto. Kath and Dave struggle to find a table at a restaurant.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Peter and Nance practice hosting friends at the "Soft Opening" of their Bed and Breakfast. A magazine features a local furniture maker in their "Man Issue." Steampunks attend a convention. Fred takes a love interest on a bold third date.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: The City of Portland is overrun with art projects. Fred and Carrie's relationship is complicated by their roommate, Alexandra. A movie theater sells artisanal concessions. The consultants from "Japanese Toys, Cool Offices" get to work.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: The Rats decide to move out of their newly gentrified neighborhood. First-time parents read various child-rearing books. Gahvin and his girlfriend go to the movies. Carrie and Alexandra have dinner at a communal table.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Electricity is shut off for the entire City of Portland due to unpaid bills at the Mayor's Office. Peter and Nance have a mysterious guest at their bed and breakfast. Kath and Dave go into survival mode.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: A young woman (Kirsten Dunst) is haunted by very informed ghosts. Doug and Claire make a big commitment to one another. Kath and Dave make the most of fifteen minutes. Sandra finally finds a soulmate. Fred is visited by a Date Fact Checker.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Ecoterrorists (including Olivia Wilde) protest animal testing at makeup company. Bryce and Lisa Rent it Out! Toni and Candace have a car wash. Fred misses hip hop.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: A celery salesman (Steve Buscemi) goes to great lengths to get celery back on the table. 911 dispatchers assure callers that it's beets. The Order Grill is open for lunch. Carrie declares social bankruptcy.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: A punk from the '80s wakes up from a coma. An e-mail goes neglected. Nina has surprising news for Lance. Malcolm and Kris tailgate a Prairie Home Companion live show. Carrie dates a tax lawyer.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Peter drives Nance to the emergency room. Spyke gets a car. Ghavin has some questions for a singer (Annie Clark) whose band is touring through Portland. Fred and Carrie have a garage sale.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Carrie and Fred go home after a concert. Fred has an idea for a music documentary. Peter is reunited with his old band, The Bahama Knights and his ex-wife lead singer (Maya Rudolph). Guest starring Maya Rudolph, Tuck & Patti, and Jeff Tweedy.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Kickstarter videos compete at the Can'ts Film Festival (hosted by Gus Van Sant). Toni and Candace coach the Portland Trail Blazers' dance team. Guest starring Gus Van Sant, Paul Allen, The Portland Trail Blazers & dancers.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.sub-title: Portlandia 408: Late in Life Drug Use
programme.desc: Brendan and Michelle decide that it's finally time to try drugs. Carrie's brother (Josh Homme) comes to visit with his new boyfriend. Women and Women First is visited by the cops. Guest starring Kyle MacLachlan, Dan Savage, and Josh Homme.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Mr. Mayor (Kyle MacLachlan) unveils Portland's official 3D Printer. Santa is concerned about the future of Christmas. A minister (Ed Begley Jr.) reminds us that church is an option.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Portlandia gets away for the weekend to New Beavertown, Oregon. Toni and Candace lead a feminist moon retreat for women (including k.d. lang).

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.sub-title: Portlandia 501: The Story of Toni and Candace
programme.desc: The origin story of the feminist bookstore. A merger between two corporate book retailers pits young, sexy, shoulder-pad-wearing Toni and Candace against one another in fierce competition to be head of the Chick Lit Department.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: A visit from Lance's mom and her new boyfriend puts pressure on Lance and Nina's relationship. Guest starring Justin Long.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: A series of health ailments creates a desperate search for medical solutions. Guest starring Ed Begley Jr. and Brigitte Nielsen.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: The Ecoterrorists travel to San Diego to take down their next target, Seaworld. Guest starring Jeff Goldblum and Natasha Lyonne.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Kath and Dave attempt the ultimate Independence Day BBQ. The Mayor searches the deep web for truly spectacular fireworks. Guest starring Kyle MacLachlan and Jane Lynch.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Portland's Dollar Store recruits Quinn as the face for their rebranding campaign. Spyke faces trial for making unlicensed Bart Simpson merchandise. Guest starring Ed Begley Jr., Matt Groening, and Oscar the Grouch.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Doug discovers that he is a male feminist. Sandra takes a rideshare for the first time. Guest starring Greta Gerwig and Graham Wagner.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Fred and Carrie's landlord moves into their house. Kath and Dave look to buy a new home for their next renovation project. Guest starring Steve Buscemi and Anna Gunn.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.sub-title: Portlandia 509: You Can Call Me Al
programme.desc: Kath and Dave scramble to rehearse for a karaoke party. Guest starring Vanessa Bayer, Jeff Goldblum, and Paul Simon.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Police begin profiling weirdos after arsonists burn down a taxidermy shop. Guest starring Paul Reubens and Olivia Wilde.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Starring Fred Armisen and Carrie Brownstein. The Flaming Lips headline Portland's Pickathon Music Festival. Brendan and Michelle attend the festival via drone. Two concertgoers go boy-crazy. Guest starring Alia Shawkat, Kyle MacLachlan.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Starring Fred Armisen and Carrie Brownstein. Fred wakes up with gray hair and sets out on a journey to find out how old he is. Carrie is faced with a life decision. Guest starring Kyle MacLachlan, Natasha Lyonne, Mitchell Hurwitz and Kumail Nanjiani.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Starring Fred Armisen and Carrie Brownstein. Fred wants to do something big with his life so he moves to Austin. Carrie is surprised when unexpected guests arrive and she finally experiences motherhood. Guest starring Alia Shawkat & Kyle MacLachlan.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Starring Fred Armisen and Carrie Brownstein. The Weirdos decide to go to the beach but are stalled when their hearse breaks down. An office worker is annoyed that everyone is using his brand new charger. Guest starring Glenn Danzig.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Starring Fred Armisen and Carrie Brownstein. Claire is finally fed up with Doug's childish behavior and breaks up with him. They both date new people and discover surprising things about themselves.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Starring Fred Armisen and Carrie Brownstein. Kath & Dave feel marginalized after an accident leaves them temporarily disabled. A car service app user dodges surge pricing by calling a cab. Joey gets an internship.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Starring Fred Armisen and Carrie Brownstein. Louis C.K. cancels a show in Portland due to a family emergency. Fred and Carrie are asked to judge a plume contest at a new vape store. Guest starring Steve Buscemi and Louis C.K.

programme.title: Portlandia

El criminal Santer intenta desviar la ruta hacia tierras apaches para explotar una mina de oro sagrada. Old Shatterhand, como técnico de mediciones, descubre el plan y busca a los apaches para evitar una guerra.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Gregory Chambers, manager of the Easterly Grange Hotel, goes missing just before the funeral of Karl Wainwright, his employer, after venturing into the woods to collect wild mushrooms. His wife tells everyone, including the police, that nothing is untoward. During a search of the woods, a severed hand is found. The case becomes more complex when the beneficiaries of Wainwright's will start receiving death threats.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Not only do Midsomer Parva's wheat fields include crop circles, they also contain an added mystery element, when the naked body of a dead man is found. It is later discovered that he was first electrocuted, has puncture marks on his back, and a chunk of his hair missing. Barnaby and Troy have their work cut out with rivalries, secret affairs and loves, jealousies and hatred.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The village doctor of Newton Magna involves the police after he accidentally hits a man in the road following a party; however, the injured man is nowhere to be found. Then the body of Robin Wooliscroft, who disappeared over a year before, is pulled up from a well. The detectives come up against suspicions, lies, disapproving families, resentments and hidden secrets before another victim is found and they get to the truth.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: In the remote hamlet of Goodman's Land, local postman and casanova Dave Cutler gets murdered whilst doing his early postal delivery. Barnaby and Troy, with WPC Jay Nash, start investigating. They discover Dave had slept with many women in the village. A witness later recalls having heard strange 1950s dance music before the murder. When others become victims to the killer, the detectives need to find a possible link to connect the murders before Jay gets into a perilous situation herself.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: As preparations are underway for Cully Barnaby's wedding, Ned Fitzroy and Beth Porteous are married in Bledlow village. At the gorgeous reception at Bledlow Hall, the maid of honour, Marina Fellowes, is found by a couple of guests murdered in an upstairs room. With the honeymoon postponed, the newlyweds and their guests find themselves being interrogated by the police.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When the name of Tommy Hicks, who was executed for cowardice and desertion during World War I, is added to the war memorial in Midsomer Parva, the Hicks family are very glad. The son and grandson, Lionel and Mayor Dave Hicks, revel in the occasion. The Hammond family are much more displeased. Henry, the patriarch, is infuriated by the move, having sustained a long-running feud with the Hickses.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The village of Dunstan, leads Barnaby and Jones to investigate the deaths of reclusive couple, Ron and Libby Wilson. Early on in the case, they learn that their son Michael had been killed in a hit and run. Not too far away a fiery dispute is in full swing, between a builder who has a very short fuse and a group of road protesters, protesting about plans for a bypass. With hostilities almost at breaking point, it is not long before another death rocks the village.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When the body of Charlie Finleyson is found in woodland in Midsomer Sonning. Barnaby and Jones begin to scrutinise the employees at the offices of Midsomer Life magazine. It is discovered that Mr Finleyson was married to the ex-wife of Guy Sandys, the wealthy owner of the magazine. The detectives also become aware of a dispute between Guy and the owner of the Morecroft Hotel. With tensions starting to rise between the locals and visitors from London.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: During a children's magic show, a performer assisting with a trick, is poisoned whilst on stage. It is found that the poison came from a species of Ecuadorean frog. Barnaby and Jones discover that conflict is once again brewing between a village occult guide and enthusiast Ernest Baillol and famous writer Aloysius Wilmington who are both searching for a treasured antique book on the subject.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A team building exercise is imminent planned by a new acting Chief Superintendent John Cotton and Barnaby and Jones are very reluctant to take part. Following an explosion in a truck at a haulage yard, both the detectives see the opportunity as a distraction to investigate. It is not long after that a body is discovered, when a trunk resurfaces from the nearby lake. It is identified as Alec Grainger, a man who had been arguing with James Parkes, the son of Colonel Matt Parkes.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: In the village of Monks Barton, two couples seemingly disappear from their cottages. When Barnaby and Jones arrive and learn of the legendary, mysterious haunted woods, they remain sceptical. Shortly after a body is found in a shallow grave, answering to the description of one of the 'missing'. The detectives have to delve much deeper into the woods and beyond to find out if ghosts are really to blame or something else.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The villagers of Milton Cross depend on lord of the manor Edward Milton, for their jobs and income. When Sonia Woodley is found murdered in the churchyard, two years after the death of her abusive husband Gerald, the murder weapon is discovered to be tailor's shears, but which one of villagers is responsible? Barnaby and Jones arrive at Woodley and Woodley, the tailors to find out, to discover that the vicar had received a letter from Sonia a few days before.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: During a council meeting, Mayor Dave Hicks announces plans to awaken an annual trip to Brighton. Barnaby suspects his proposal to buy coastal land there is a fraud. Barnaby reluctantly joins the party, but during their time in Brighton, hated property developer Hugh Dalgleish is beheaded on a ghost train ride. The detectives together with Tom's cousin DCI John Barnaby gather who from the party or someone else could have been responsible before other murders occur and secrets are uncovered.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Ford Florey is anything but quiet, when the Wild West Society bring their show and fair, consisting of many stalls and a shooting re-enactment. programme.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL)
programme.sub-title: WPBL 2026 - Bengaluru vs Rajasthan - Day 9 Tie 1
programme.desc: Experience the high-octane energy of the World Pickleball League (WPBL) Season 2 as the Bengaluru Jawans go head-to-head with the Rajasthan Titans at the iconic Jio World Garden in Mumbai. The stakes are higher than ever in this Day 9, Tie 16 clash, featuring elite matchups such as the "women's singles player of the season" Katrina Stewart facing off against the resilient Lorena Dupnik. Watch as tactical masters like Dusty Boyer and Jack Foster battle for supremacy in a series of intense singles and mixed doubles competitions where every point counts toward the league standings. With game-changing "Pickle Plays" and atmospheric "drums" fueling the intensity, this tie is a masterclass in professional grit and strategic precision.

programme.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL)
programme.sub-title: WPBL 2026 - Bengaluru vs Delhi - Day 4 Tie 2
programme.desc: The World Pickleball League Season 2 returns to the Jio World Garden in Mumbai for an electrifying Tie 8 showdown. The defending champions, Bengaluru Jawans—led by coach Oliver Strecker and backed by owners Atlee and Priya—return to the court for the first time since their dominant opening night performance. They face a determined Delhi Dilwale squad, coached by Wesley Gabrielsson, who are looking to climb the standings after a hard-fought tie-break victory in their previous outing.

programme.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL)
programme.sub-title: WPBL 2026 - Chennai vs Bengaluru - Day 7 Tie 1
programme.desc: The stakes reach a boiling point at Mumbai's Jio World Garden as the league-leading Chennai Super Champs face off against the defending champions, the Bengaluru Jawans, in a critical top-of-the-table clash. Witness a masterclass in professional grit as "dominating" stars like Katrina Stewart and tactical veterans like Dusty Boyer battle for supremacy on the road to the semi-finals. Experience the strategic drama of game-changing "Pickle Plays" and high-stakes challenges in a tie where one momentum shift could decide who walks away with the top spot in the league.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: A five-round heavyweight title eliminator between the number one ranked contender Levi Rigters (18-2, 8 KO) and ‘The Golden Wolf’ Bahram Rajabzadeh (69-3, 61 KO). The winner will face ‘The King of Kickboxing’ Rico Verhoeven (64-10, 21 KO) on December 7 in the main event of COLLISION 7. In the co-main event of the evening, Tariq ‘Cookie’ Osaro (25-4-1, 13 KO) clashes with Nico ‘Big Sexy’ Horta (23-9, 3 KO) in a monster heavyweight clash with big implication for the rankings. Croatian kickboxing legend Mladen Brestovac (55-14-1, 37 KO) will make his final walk to the ring in his hometown of Zagreb. ‘The Scorpion Sting’ will take on newcomer Karim Dian (16-13, 3 KO) to cap off an illustrious career. Top ten heavyweights Nordine Mahieddine (28-15, 13 KO) and Nikola Filipovic (11-2, 6 KO) will collide in what is a guaranteed barn burner between two prolific KO artist.

In the co-main event, Donovan Wisse (21-1, 10 KO) aims to defend his GLORY middleweight world championship for a fifth time when he welcomes the challenge of top German Sergej Braun (44-13, 27 KO).

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are in beautiful Norway for the kick off of the 2017 MLO Strongman Champions League season. With partly cloudy weather and lots of snow, we have the perfect scenery for the athletes, who prepare for the first contest of the year.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: A definite highlight in this FIBO edition in Germany, Strongman Champions League introduced its new rules for a special team item. Graham Hicks tries here to set a New World Record on the biggest log in the world, currently held by Krzysztof Radzikowski. Boosted also by the presence of the acclaimed in the strongman circles names of Mark Felix and Danis Zageris.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This weekend sees the Strongman Champions League Log Lift World Championships in Lithuania. Big lifting names such as Graham Hicks , Vidas Blekaitis and Vytatus Lalas are in the startlist to push some big numbers.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The battle of the Dutch will take place this edition in Lichtenvoorde, a place very well known in Holland because of the famous “Black Cross”. The athletes will compete over six heavy events and the winner gets 25 Strongman Champions League ranking points.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Set in the beautiful mountain resort Zlatibor, the fifth stage of the Strongman Champions League 2017 sees 14 athletes from across the world competing for the gold medal of SCL Serbia 2017. The event welcomes top-athlete - and odds-on favourite - Matjaz Belsak (Slovenia), who has presented himself in an impressive shape so far. Can his opponents defeat him?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The next two stages take place in Quebec. With eight events over two days, SCL Canada is a true ‘heavyweight’. The athletes compete in: Truck Pull, Deadlift with cars, Log Lift, and the Atlas Stones. The World’s Strongest Viking Jean-Francois Caron from Canada is a favourite, as well as current SCL leader Matjaz Belsak (Slovenia) and promising underdog Jimmy Paquet (Canada).

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to the second day in Quebec. The athletes are fighting hard to win this two-day event. The last points of this SCL stage can be won over four outstanding disciplines: Power Stairs, Dumbbell Press, Keg Toss, and finally, the legendary Farmer’s Walk. Who will leave Canada with the yellow ‘Leader Shirt’?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Stages 8 and 9 of the SCL are hosted in Vaasa, Finland, taking place over a spectacular two-day event. After 3 wins so far, Matjaz Belsak from Slovenia plans to extend his lead at the top of the table. Among the other 13 highly motivated strongmen, two SCL legends will make their comeback to the competition: Former World Champion of 2015, Krzysztof Radzikowski (Poland) and Dainis Zageris (Latvia).

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The fight for the Finnish trophy continues. In this unmissable SCL event, the strongmen battle for the win in the Carry and Drag, the Forward Hold, Deadlifting with Cars and the Loading Race. Belsak, Radzikowski and Zageris look good after the first day, but the others haven’t given up yet.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 10, Finland Lightweight World Championship
programme.desc: This under 105kg category event is the ultimate preparation for up-and-coming strongman athletes before entering the heavy class. The Lightweight World Championship is a special every year in the SCL calendar as it sees new talents rise and many promising athletes who are gearing up for future tournaments. A total of 25 athletes from 16 different countries make their way to Kokkola, Finland

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Situated in the very heart of the Carpathian Mountains, Sibiu is a Romanian town where the climate is pleasantly mild, offering some of the best weather conditions for a strongman event around Europe. All this, without doubt, set the mood for the high results and showtime vibes in Stage 11 of Strongman Champions League. The competition in Sibiu was organized in six different disciplines

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: From now on every stage of these series will be more than crucial. Curacao is a beautiful Dutch island in the Caribbean, with a great atmosphere to hold another stage of the MLO Strongman Champions League. Let’s see who takes the title here and who will secure a place in the next stage.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Ten of the world’s strongest men gathered in Amman to compete in Jordan’s first-ever Truck-Pull Championship. The contestants race against the clock while pulling a 21-ton truck across the track. One of the most fierce competitors to take part in the event was four-time winner of the World’s Strongest Man competition, Brian Shaw.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

In front of more than 5000 spectators, the twelve athletes compete in Log Lifts, Card Deadlift, Conan’s Wheel and Loading.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 15, Mexico World Finals (Part 1)
programme.desc: The first day of the two-part finale sees the strongest men competing in Carry and Drag, Dumbbell Lift and the Truck Pull. Everything is possible in this heated fight for the crown against the backdrop of stunning Chetumal, Mexico.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 16, Mexico World Finals (Part 2)
programme.desc: On the second day of the grand finale of the 2017 Strongman Champions League, the athletes have a last chance to secure the medals in the spectacular four events Weight for Height, Deadlift Cars, Forward Hold and The Loading Medley. programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.desc: Julio exige que Sofía le devuelva el dinero que pagó por sus cirugías; ella lo acusa de querer prostituirla. Anabel quiere recuperar la custodia de su hijo; teme por el bienestar del niño.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Marie quiere que Rodolfo le devuelva su hijo, él dice que lo hará solo si ella cambia de pareja. Jesús exige una indemnización, Mercedes resucitó a su anciana madre y ahora ella debe cuidarla.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Cenizas para facial; Abusada y sin sus hijas
programme.desc: Yamily demanda a su hermano; él pretende invertir las cenizas de su abuela en un novedoso negocio. Susana pierde la custodia de sus hijos, intentó suicidarse por un trauma, fue abusada de niña.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Diana exige que Iván le pague salarios atrasados y reconozca la paternidad de su hijo. David quiere enterrar juntas a su madre y a la esposa de esta, pero la directora del cementerio no lo permite.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Boxeador desmemoriado; Ciudadanía en cuestión por droga
programme.desc: Antonella pide ayuda psicológica para su esposo, su trabajo lo convirtió en un hombre violento. Luisa se casa con Javier, él le ofrece los papeles, pero oculta su pasado como narcotraficante.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Ébola mortal; Ley en California: Sí significa sí
programme.desc: Miller quiere anular su matrimonio con José, tiene ébola y lo ocultó, además vende su sangre infectada. Luis demanda a su exnovia, ella le complicó la vida al acusarlo de forzarla a tener sexo.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: "Depredador" en Halloween; Adopta, mi hijo no
programme.desc: Angélica descubre que su esposo y padre de su niña es un depredador sexual, pide el divorcio. Antonio pierde a su hijo cuando la madre desaparece, ahora le exige a su ex cuñada que lo devuelva.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: La muñeca mujer maravilla; Olor a pescado
programme.desc: Sueña con someterse a una cirugía plástica que le permita lucir igual que una muñeca. Florencia es joven, bella y de buen corazón, pero no es feliz; su cuerpo despide un olor nauseabundo.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Mucho selfie, poco sexo; Estoy en el certificado, es mío
programme.desc: Mariana está enganchada a los selfies, su esposo la demanda, por su vicio, ya no tienen sexo. Tatiana pide la custodia de su sobrino, la madre está presa y su excuñado no es el padre biológico.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Profesor golpeado; Novia de ella y amante de la momia
programme.desc: Roberto es profesor y demanda a la madre de su novia, cuando ella descubrió la relación le dio una paliza. Victoria le exige a la amante de su marido que devuelva los bienes que él le entregó.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Jean quiere abortar, grabar el procedimiento y comercializar el video. Sofia, su ex, se opone. Killer acaba de salir de prisión y le exige a Fabiana, su excuñada, que le devuelva a sus gemelas.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Fotos del miembro; Viudo esquizofrénico con custodia
programme.desc: Catalina recibe fotos donde su jefe le muestra el miembro, ella lo denuncia y él la demanda. Además, Yassiri exige la custodia de las hijas de Jonathan, él es esquizofrénico y puede ser peligroso.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Basta de indocumentados; Abuelo se pone vestido
programme.desc: Mayra exige que su actual pareja le devuelva el dinero que le entregó porque necesita ayudar a su hijo. Rosa pide la custodia de su padre, su sobrina usa al abuelo para promocionar sus diseños.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Renuncia en TV por marihuana; Padrastro no quiere niña, ella sí
programme.desc: Martín, dueño de un canal online, demanda a Ivana porque usó la plataforma para vender drogas. Karina le pide a su ex que no abandone a su niña —no es su hija biológica—, pero ella no lo sabe.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: No quiero a mi prostituta madre; Niña de 14 quiere su hijo
programme.desc: Nazarena le exige a su marido que desaloje a la mujer que la abandonó a los tres años, su madre biológica. Jessica tiene 14 años y un bebé; los abuelos paternos le piden que entregue al niño.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: 17 años con cáncer pide divorcio de padres; Casi viuda 51 expresivamente sexual
programme.desc: Celimar tiene 17 años y para sobrellevar su enfermedad en paz quiere que sus padres se separen. María se dedica a vivir la vida loca con el dinero de su esposo, desde que este cayó en coma.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Suegra con Guillain Barre Syndrome; Sin vagina nací
programme.desc: Lorena demanda a su marido, él tiene sexo con su suegra enferma, según dice, para ayudarla. Lorena nació sin vagina, por eso quiere usar el dinero que ha ahorrado con su esposo para operarse.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Ángel demanda a Estela, la madre de su hija de 12 años, y le exige que reconozca su paternidad, pero ella se niega, alega que la niña vivió un trauma y por eso rechaza a los homosexuales.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Pareja de un circo; Terapia de mordiscos
programme.desc: Rafael y Samanta son una pareja de acróbatas, ella quiere aceptar un nuevo trabajo, pero él no. Mariana inventa una terapia contra la eyaculación precoz usando mordiscos, ahora la acosan.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Rosalba prohíbe la entrada de homosexuales a su restaurante, su hijo la demanda, no comparte sus ideas. Luis exige que Andrea interne a su hijo autista para protegerla, ella pide el divorcio.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Juego de rol; Hija de mi hermano
programme.desc: Victoria fue víctima de un juego de roles, su boda y su marido son falsos, la usaron para grabar un video. Johana exige que su cuñado asuma la paternidad de su bebé, la esposa de él se opone.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Paco demanda a su expareja por plagio, alega que le robó una aplicación para encuentros de tríos. Bruno exige que su esposa Helena desaloje a su familia y a su ex, que los trajo sin avisarle.

programme.title: Caso Cerrado
programme.desc: Miembros de la iglesia católica debatirán los asuntos actuales que han surgido en los medios desde la controversia del Padre Alberto.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Marido fluffer; Hija enferma de otro
programme.desc: El trabajo de Juan es calentar a los actores porno antes de grabar; su esposa quiere el divorcio. Andrés descubre que su hija es fruto de una infidelidad; quiere dejar a su esposa y a la niña.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Que esposa regrese a Venezuela; Hijo sugiere eutanasia para mamá
programme.desc: Yudi abandona a su familia para ganar una competencia, su esposo le exige que se ocupe del niño. Loreta demanda a su esposa porque quiere someterse a un suicidio asistido e involucra a su hijo.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Niño con bola en cuello falsa; Adopción gay
programme.desc: Julio quiere el divorcio y la custodia de su hijo, la madre usa al niño para recaudar dinero en internet. Pablo e Iñaki contratan a una madre subrogada, ahora se divorcian y no saben qué hacer.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: El hombre con la cabeza atrás; Fotos con orgasmos
programme.desc: Yenni exige la aprobación de su esposo para dar en adopción a su hija que tiene una grave malformación. Pedro demanda a su empleadora, quien lo incitó a masturbarse ante la cámara y luego lo despidió.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Maestros armados; Gemelas de 17 casarse con tercero
programme.desc: Marlene aprueba que los maestros porten armas, su esposo no, ella quiere el divorcio y la custodia de su hija. Sasha pide la emancipación de sus gemelas, alega que ya no puede controlarlas.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Niña pintora, padre abusador; ¿Qué hacemos con María desnuda?
programme.desc: Melissa es pintora y tiene nueve años, afirma que su padre la explota, quiere vivir con su abuela. Ana pide que sus cuñados se ocupen de su suegra, perdió la razón y ella no puede cuidarla.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Me casé con suegro x papeles; Bebé muere asfixiada
programme.desc: Ana se casó con Juan, su suegro, para obtener la residencia. Además, una bebé murió ahogada por su hermana mayor. La madre culpa al padre porque, mientras ocurría la tragedia, el hombre estaba teniendo sexo con la niñera que debía cuidar a las niñas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos

programme.title: El señor de los cielos

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio cae en los brazos de Esperanza y su amiga. Rivero ordena investigar los negocios de Rutila, mientras ella roba información de su computadora, a pedido del Chema. Omar alerta a Mónica.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio les dice a sus socios que ahora se dedica al lavado de dinero y Víctor queda en su lugar. Por orden de Rivero, allanan el local de Rutila y Mónica, y hallan químicos para fabricar éxtasis.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Víctor se enfrenta a Carreño y mata a uno de sus hombres: jura que eliminará al general venezolano la próxima vez que le diga traidor a su tío. Feyo le confiesa a la Condesa que asesinó a Juan.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos

programme.title: El señor de los cielos

programme.title: El señor de los cielos

programme.title: El señor de los cielos

programme.title: El señor de los cielos

programme.title: El señor de los cielos

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Celia entra a cirugía para dar a luz y sufre un paro cardíaco, pero el Dr. Orozco logra salvarla. Alejandro cumple su penitencia pidiendo perdón al barrio y confiesa su amor por Margot. Katiuska revela sus planes de casarse con Ricardo por dinero, mientras Juan Marcos intenta detenerla. María del Pilar tiene un encuentro romántico con Gustavo del que se arrepiente, a la vez que recibe un apartamento de Marcelo. Elizabeth rechaza la presencia de Katiuska en la clínica.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Celia está fuera de peligro y revela su enfermedad a Ricardo, quien se desespera. Katiuska, furiosa tras ser expulsada de la clínica por Ricardo, ordena a Carrero eliminar a Celia. Mientras tanto, René se aleja definitivamente de Marcelo pese a los intentos de Graciela. Manuela perdona a Ricardo pero no olvida, enfocándose en el bienestar de Celia. Margot inicia una relación con Alejandro, y Marcelo se enfrenta violentamente a Gustavo por el amor de María del Pilar.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Ricardo se entera de la verdad y Elizabeth le pide no casarse con Katiuska. Alejandro declara su amor a Manuela. Los médicos informan que a Celia le queda poco tiempo de vida; Katiuska envía a Carrero para eliminarla, pero él huye al ser descubierto. Vincenzo y Tirsa revelan la existencia de un testamento actualizado en Italia. Ricardo, harto de las presiones de Katiuska y su familia por la boda, rompe la lista de invitados y abandona la casa para apoyar a Manuela y Celia.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Ricardo deja a Katiuska y se va de su casa. Celia regresa a su hogar en estado grave, mientras Manuela busca a su hermana Cecilia para que se reconcilien. Vincenzo y Tirsa informan sobre el testamento de la Nona. Katiuska manipula a Glorita para que odie a Ricardo y enfrenta una orden de ADN de Misael. Marcelo se indigna por la confesión de María del Pilar sobre Gustavo. Ricardo considera casarse con Manuela para darle una última alegría a Celia, quien elige a Juan Marcos como padrino.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Glorita escapa tras descubrir mentiras de Katiuska. Cecilia llega a Caracas, causando impacto por su parecido con Celia, a quien confronta por culpas pasadas. Marcelo pide el divorcio a Graciela para casarse con María del Pilar. Benjamín retiene a Carrero, pero Katiuska lo libera tras un montaje violento para incriminarlo. Celia, debilitada, pide ser enterrada con su vestido de novia. María del Pilar presiona a Marcelo para casarse tras cambios laborales de este.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Angie le pide explicaciones a Magdalena sobre las fotos que vio en el periódico de ella con Gabriel. Magdalena insiste en que es un malentendido, pero Angie no le cree. Gabriel va a la prensa y se ocupa de armar un escándalo por esto, pidiendo que se retracten públicamente por el artículo, pero Ricardo no planea hacerlo, y contraatacar nuevamente. Más tarde, Gabriel vuelve a su casa, y Angie lo espera enfurecida. Agustín le pregunta a Sofía sobre Magdalena y Gabriel, pero ella no le dice nada. Luego, Magdalena regresa a su casa, y cuando Agustín llega se pone romántico, hasta que finalmente le pregunta sobre su relación con Gabriel. Efraín llama a Valentina para citarla, pero su esposa llega, y él disimula que arregla una reunión de trabajo.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Tanto Gabriel como Magdalena pelean con su pareja, porque éstos no les creen que la prensa armó una historia sobre ellos, que ellos dicen no es verdadera. Angie no se tranquiliza aún, y llama a un detective para vigilar la situación de cerca. Agustín aprovecha la escena para causarle culpa a Magdalena, mientras él la sigue engañando con Sofía. Luego, Magdalena va a una fiesta, donde tomas algunas fotos, y se encuentra con Ricardo, a quien le da una cachetada por haber escrito ese artículo sobre ella en la revista. Magdalena sale beneficiada por esto, ya que un hombre la felicita y le ofrece un trabajo en el interior del país.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Agustín confronta a Gabriel en la calle para dejarle claro que no se vuelva a meter con su mujer. Magdalena descubre en el baño de la casa de Sofía perfume y otras cosas de hombre, por lo que a ella no le queda más remedio que confesar que tiene novio. Magdalena se extraña, ya que siendo su amiga no le contó antes, y Sofía dice que no le contó antes porque el hombre es casado. Luego, Magdalena le cuenta esto a Agustín, y cuando Agustín se encuentra con Sofía se enoja con ella por no poder haber inventado otra excusa. A Gabriel le ofrecen ir a hacer un discurso a Caja Seca, un pueblo cercano, para, entre otras cosas, desviar la atención de los medios por el problema con Magdalena. Gabriel acepta, y Gloria lo acompaña.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Gabriel debe alejarse de la ciudad para llegar a un pueblo llamado Caja Seca por razones de trabajo. Lo que nunca se imagina es que Magdalena se encuentre en ese pueblo también por asuntos laborales, y el destino hace que se junten. Gloria decide contarle a Gabriel que ella ya está al tanto de la enfermedad que tiene él en los riñones. Su intención es ayudarlo en lo que necesite y que pueda confiar en ella. Sin embargo, él siente que la gente le puede llegar a tener lástima y, por eso, quiere callar. Angie y Agustín están desesperados por comunicarse con sus respectivas parejas. Ellos llaman a Gabriel y a Magdalena pero no obtienen ninguna respuesta.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Magdalena es llevada a su casa por Gabriel León. Esto les causa una situación incómoda ya que los dos están casados. Al entrar en su casa, Magdalena encuentra a su hijo Rodrigo llorando en el armario. El papá, Agustín, lo había retado y dejado solo para irse a una reunión con Angie, la esposa de Gabriel. Epicúreo sigue en su papel de homosexual frente a Valentina, para así ganarse su amistad y respeto. Por otro lado, Maikel no está conforme con la mentira, ya que Julieta cree que es verdad que ambos son pareja. Efraín le escribe un poema a Valentina, pero Ana Belén cree que es para ella. Primero se alegra y luego se deprime, al darse cuenta que no habla de ella, sino de otra mujer.

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: Guillermo le consulta a Marilda por una supuesta reconciliación con Cristóbal, después de haber escuchado una conversación entre él y Ana; ante la negación de Marilda, Guillermo encuentra una posibilidad para terminar de conquistar a Ana, porque entendió que, para Cristóbal, Ana sería segunda en su lista de amores. A pesar de ello, Cristóbal se convence que debe comprar el apartamento lindero al de su primo Guillermo, y accede a firmar los registros del préstamo bancario y así, consumar la compra, a pesar de que Ana decidió no mudarse al lado del hombre que le quita el sueño por las noches, y al que sólo lo ha visto dos veces en su vida,

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.sub-title: Episodio 6: No fue una metida de pata, fueron dos
programme.desc: Cristóbal y su primo Guillermo conversan en la plaza, Cristóbal se muestra aún vengativo con Marilda y empeñado en no fallar en su nuevo matrimonio con Ana. Pablo visita a su hija Ana y le cuenta del Fantasma, mientras Ana a él, de Guillermo, su verdadero amor. Venancio vuelve de buscar a su hijo del colegio, en el ascensor se cruza con Pedro, este se pone nervioso y Venancio lo percibe. Carlota recibe a Venancio y su nieto; Venancio expresa sus celos por Lázara. Pedro lo está espiando, nervioso, con sus cámaras, así se entera de que vive en el edificio. Mientras Barranco y Ana conversan, llega su ex, María José, y comienzan a discutir fuerte

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: Nancy se retira furiosa de la junta de condominio, Pedro logra que Carlos Enrique se quede hablando con Lázara en lugar de ir detrás de su mujer. Patricia deja de estudiar y se va de la casa, harta de las burlas de Carlitos. Al pasar por delante de Pedrote este la intercepta para flirtear con ella y darle celos a Purita. Nancy los ve juntos y se indigna más aún. Cristóbal reserva el salón del condominio para casarse con Ana, ante los ojos de Guillermo. Nancy se queja con Carlitos de lo sucedido en la junta con su padre, pero a Carlitos sólo le interesa enterarse de que Purita quedó sola. Pedro logra que Cristóbal ponga de padrino de bodas al mismísimo Guillermo, generando incomodidad entre él y Ana.

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: Pedro tiene montado en una de las habitaciones de su apartamento un sistema de espionaje a los vecinos del condominio. Con cámaras instaladas dentro de las viviendas, va manejando y observando las conversaciones y los detalles de la vida de cada uno de los habitantes del complejo. Es así que se entera de todos los pormenores, y entre ellos descubre a Cristóbal en una conversación consigo mismo en donde deja a la luz su sospecha de infidelidad entre Ana y su primo Guillermo.

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: Cristóbal tiene cada vez más sospechas sobre Ana y Guillermo, y los invita a un almuerzo para tratar de que ellos durante una charla confiesen involuntariamente que se conocían de antes. Ellos tratan de conversar como si nada pasara, pero es imposible ambos estan enamorados y tratan de evitar que Cristóbal se dé cuenta. La idea del almuerzo fue de Pedro que como espía a todos en el edificio, sabe lo que le pasa a cada persona que vive allí. Venancio sigue sospechando de Pedro y su relación con el hombre muerto que apareció junto al río, pero el estafador aprovechará el interrogatorio para dar vuelta el tablero y sembrar celos de Venancio hacia Lázara, la ex mujer del policía.

programme.title: Episodio 106 (2026)
programme.desc: Armando totalmente borracho le va a llevar una serenata a Briggite. Ella la recibe maravillada como siempre y cuando se van los mariachis | el se arrodilla y le dice que la ama. Finita se pone a conversar sola ya que Fabián está durmiendo la borrachera y se pone a pensar que le inventa a Armando y lo único que le viene a la cabeza es decirle que tiene una enfermedad terminal. Solymar saca a bailar a Wilker que está totalmente en otro mundo. El acepta pero pensando en Yubiri.

programme.title: Episodio 107 (2026)
programme.desc: Briggite les cuenta a Ana y a Finita lo de Armando. Finita se desmaya Armando y Atanasio se encuentran y comienzan hablar de Graciela y en este momento de Briggite. Bienvenida va donde Junior y le dice que acepta trabajar en su película. Junior le entrega el guión con unas palabras que hacen llorar a Bienvenida Solymar se porta como novia de Wilker y este no dice nada. Yubiri cree esto y se va para que ellos hablen. Gisela y Juan Diego están de compras y ven a Yubiri.

programme.title: Episodio 108 (2026)
programme.desc: Armando bota definitivamente a Finita de su oficina y de su vida. Por más que ella quiso explicarle | el no aceptó ninguna explicación y la sacó. Briggite anda perdida como siempre. No sabe lo que está haciendo caminando por un pasillo del centro comercial. Pero se encuentra con Yubiri y aprovecha para decirle que regrese a la agencia. Fabián sigue con el ratón. Llega Palma el Productor para darle una gran noticia a Wilker y es que consiguió una presentación en Sábado Sensacional.

programme.title: Episodio 109 (2026)
programme.desc: Yubiri está super feliz en su casa repartiendo regalos a su familia y todos están que brincan de la felicidad. Lolita le dice a Wilker que la gorrita se la regaló Yubiri. Llega Solymar y comienzan a hablar sobre lo de la presentación. ROKUro y Segundo conversan de los regalos hechos por Yubiri para estrenarlos con sus respectivas conquistas. En casa de Briggite están hablando ella Carolina y Dionisia de quienes se están por casar. Llega Junior para informarles que al otro día se casa.

programme.title: Episodio 110 (2026)
programme.desc: Junior y los demás están recibiendo a los invitados. Llega Pastor con Ana. Todos se sorprenden pro Olegario está que ni habla. Dionisia y ROKUro se citan en una heladería. Dionisia piensa que es para decirle la verdad | que no es médico. Pero el lo que hace es darle una tarjeta con su teléfono. Dionisia está feliz y no le importa que no le diga nada. Ya van a casar a Junior y a Jésica cuando llega Briggite y Armando. Se para la boda momentáneamente. Finita va a hablar con Armando.

programme.title: Grand Earth

programme.desc: Mountains provide a splendid backdrop for communities but they’re also important ecological landscapes. Approximately one-tenth of the world’s population depends on mountains for their life-support.

programme.title: Grand Earth
programme.sub-title: Water: Lake Titicaca, Peru; The Badjao of Bohol, Phillipines
programme.desc: Deserts. Forests. Caves. Mountains. How have human beings adapted to living in the world’s most extraordinary environments? The sheer magnificence of the natural world takes centre stage in this exploration of some of Earth’s most beautiful and most unforgiving environments and the people who have, against the odds, made these places their home.

programme.title: Authentic Escapes
programme.desc: In this unforgettable episode of Authentic Escapes, Sandra McLemore uncovers the heart of Istanbul—a city where East meets West, and ancient tradition blends seamlessly with modern life. From the vibrant Spice Bazaar filled with Turkish delight and tea, to Michelin-starred Ottoman cuisine that revives centuries-old royal recipes, Sandra dives deep into the flavors and culture of this mesmerizing destination. She explores the mysterious Basilica Cistern, a hidden underground marvel, and reveals the artistry behind handwoven Turkish carpets—each a story told in knots and color. With practical travel tips, immersive storytelling, and a few laughs along the way, this episode is both a guide and a love letter to one of the world’s most captivating cities. Whether you're drawn to history, food, shopping, or simply want to experience something magical, Istanbul delivers—and this episode shows you why it belongs on every traveler’s bucket list.

programme.title: Edible Nutmeg: On the Road
programme.desc: In this episode, we follow Chef Plum as he visits Gilbertie's Herb Garden in Easton, CT, to chat with owner Sal Gilbertie about his nursery where he tosses a delicious carrot and microgreen salad with fresh ricotta and a bacon-mustard vinaigrette.

programme.title: Authentic Escapes
programme.desc: In this episode of Authentic Escapes, host Sandra McLemore uncovers the heart and soul of Budapest, Hungary’s enchanting capital. From panoramic views at Fisherman’s Bastion to the colorful stalls of Central Market Hall, she explores the city’s rich blend of history, food, and culture. Sandra soaks in centuries of tradition at the famous Gellért Thermal Baths, where locals come daily to relax in mineral-rich waters. She then dines at the legendary Gundel Restaurant, where Hungarian staples like goulash and Gundel pancakes are served with royal flair and historical significance. Between bites and baths, Sandra shares practical travel tips—how to ride the tram, when to cross the Danube for the best sunset views, and why you should book Parliament tickets in advance. Whether you're drawn to architecture, cuisine, or unforgettable experiences, this episode proves that Budapest is a city worth savoring—one authentic moment at a time.

programme.title: New Zealand From Above
programme.desc: An aerial journey over New Zealand from the deep south of the South Island to the northern tip of the North Island. We discover the landscapes and meet New Zealanders who talk about their work, interests, and culture.

programme.title: Going Beyond
programme.desc: Going Beyond is wanderlust-filled hitchhiker Mariia Khandus’s new travel project. She’s journeyed around the world. Everybody knows that Thailand, Vietnam, and Indonesia are great places to relax with wonderful beaches and delicious fruits! But what do you know about the local people? The expats? About the real lives of those living in these exotic countries? In our trip, we will discover it all, together! We visit the non-touristy places and show you the real Indochina! This is a set of stories of different people, through the prism of whom we show life in a country. It is a collection of diverse achievements, experiences and emotions. We are looking for the most interesting stories for you to keep expanding your own consciousness. Unbelievable panoramic views, interesting people, exciting stories and adventures – you’ll see all of this in our travel show, Going Beyond!

This is a set of stories of different people, through the prism of whom we show life in a country. It is a collection of diverse achievements, experiences and emotions. We are looking for the most interesting stories for you to keep expanding your own consciousness. Unbelievable panoramic views, interesting people, exciting stories and adventures – you’ll see all of this in our travel show, Going Beyond!

programme.title: Clockwatchers (1997)
programme.desc: Friendship helps make nightmarish office jobs bearable for four young women working as temporary employees.

programme.title: Dead Man (1995)
programme.desc: Circumstances transform a mild-mannered accountant (Johnny Depp) into a notorious Old West gunslinger.

programme.title: Homegrown (1998)
programme.desc: A go-between (Kelly Lynch) helps California marijuana growers (Billy Bob Thornton, Hank Azaria) take action when their boss is killed.

programme.title: Space Mutiny (1988)
programme.desc: A space hero (Reb Brown) puts down mutineers (John Phillip Law, James Ryan) on a huge ship taking earthlings to a far planet.

programme.title: Piranha (1995)
programme.desc: A government tank containing genetically engineered piranha is unwittingly emptied into a river that flows past a resort area.

programme.title: FernGully 2: The Magical Rescue (1998)
programme.desc: Two Fern Gully faeries leave the rain forest to save three baby animals from poachers.

programme.title: Basquiat (1996)
programme.desc: Self-destructiveness and disdain for the middle class mark the life of artist Jean-Michel Basquiat, dead of an overdose in 1988.

programme.title: Space Truckers (1997)
programme.desc: A freight pilot (Dennis Hopper), his girlfriend (Debi Mazar) and an apprentice (Stephen Dorff) try to deliver cargo to Earth in 2197.

programme.title: The Crush (1993)
programme.desc: A writer (Cary Elwes) moves into a wealthy family's guest house and befriends a precocious 14-year-old daughter (Alicia Silverstone).

programme.title: Living With Dinosaurs
programme.desc: Troubled 9-year-old Dom has a stuffed dinosaur that comes to life.

programme.title: Pacific Heights (1990)
programme.desc: San Francisco yuppies (Melanie Griffith, Matthew Modine) restore a costly Victorian, then rent a studio to a landlord's nightmare (Michael Keaton).

programme.title: Jeffrey (1995)
programme.desc: A 30-ish, gay New Yorker (Steven Weber) swears off sex, then falls for an HIV-positive guy (Michael T. Weiss) he meets at the gym.

programme.title: Funny Games (1997)
programme.desc: Two sadistic collegians torture a vacationing Austrian family (Susanne Lothar, Ulrich Mühe) physically and psychologically.

programme.title: Fever Pitch (1997)
programme.desc: A teacher (Colin Firth), obsessed with soccer and a team that hasn't won a league cup in 18 years, begins a shaky relationship.

programme.title: Poison (2024)
programme.desc: From the fields in the Caserta region, the Camorra seems as distant as fires burning on the horizon. Instead, it is as close as a brother can be who almost spills his rubbish in the countryside where he grew up. A buffalo farmer refuses to sell off his family's land to a young candidate for mayor of his village. When he discovers that he is ill with cancer, caused by toxic waste illegally disposed of in the countryside of the ‘terra dei fuochi’, his wife will carry on his battle.

programme.title: A Sky Full of Stars for a Roof (2024)
programme.desc: Two drifters meet and soon become travelling companions. But one of them, Tim (Gemma), is being chased by a crazed killer and his band of gunmen to settle an old score. The two (Adore being the other) are chased through the west, encountering scrape after scrape until the killers catch up and the score is settled for good.

programme.title: Youtopia (2025)
programme.desc: A young woman faces moral dilemmas and hardship in a poignant story of hope and despair.

programme.title: Hands of Steel (2025)
programme.desc: Programmed to kill, a rogue cyborg defies his mission and fights for humanity’s survival.

programme.title: Lady Chatterly story (2024)
programme.desc: Released from prison, Lord Chatterley's former gardener is once again employed by his master. Right on time, love blossoms again with Madame Joelle. Their new relationship will be a crescendo of morbidity and perversion.

programme.title: The violent patriot (2026)
programme.desc: A legendary 16th-century Italian captain leads his soldiers to defend his land against invaders.

programme.title: The Rangers (2026)
programme.desc: A commando infiltrates a Nazi POW camp on a suicide mission to destroy a secret weapons program.

programme.title: Even Angels Eat Beans (2025)
programme.desc: Striving for a higher standard of living, a former ice-cream man and a wrestler convince a well-known mobster to hire them. However, they both soon realize that criminal life is not what they were looking for.

programme.title: Made in Italy: Ciao Brother (2024)
programme.desc: Angelo makes a living selling fake paintings, but is unmasked and forced to flee to the United States. Arriving in Los Angeles with no money, he pretends to be the son of a wealthy, recently deceased Italian-American businessman. Will he be able to convince George, the real descendant?

programme.title: Creeping Death (2026)
programme.desc: Undercover agent Alan Fields hunts a rogue thief who killed his partners to keep the stolen loot.

programme.title: Stay Away from Trinity... When He Comes to Eldorado (2026)
programme.desc: A crafty con artist disguises himself as a priest to trick bandits and hunt for hidden gold.

programme.title: The violent patriot (2026)
programme.desc: A legendary 16th-century Italian captain leads his soldiers to defend his land against invaders.

programme.title: The Rangers (2026)
